cards.title: OURS — VEL-WEEKENDER-HAALAND-01 (36s)  ·  Brooks script 9/02, spoken-delivery pass, VO gringo clone take A

cards.text: NOTES

cards.title: VO (fixed 9/02)
cards.text: Library voices rejected as robotic. Shipped: IVC clone of tiktok @randomgringo (gringo-tiktok-male, hnRXaWYxr5tqZBrH55Cp) on eleven_v3 Creative, take A, 35.4s / 186 wpm, brand clean. Take D (light tags) is the alternate. C1 re-lipsynced on HeyGen. Never atempo.

cards.title: Format
cards.text: Keyed creator bottom-left, cut by the frame edge (head 20% of frame width, head centre 16% in from the edge, body 60px past the bottom). C1: head 492px on the plate, scaled 474x843 at x=-138 y=1137.

cards.title: Captions
cards.text: 46px white, soft dark stroke, one or two lines, centred at y1620 across his chest, word-synced.

cards.title: Cuts
cards.text: Hard cuts, static holds. No Ken Burns.

cards.title: Creator
cards.text: Propped-phone TikTok framing, hand up mid-gesture, lips parted, window light, real skin; HeyGen Avatar V. C1 motion delta 8.8 (healthy 7-10).

cards.title: Casting
cards.text: C1 v1 (rendered) + v2 green. C3 v1-v3 green. C2 failed green 9 of 9 rolls; BEN2 matte route if that look is wanted.

cards.title: Open rulings
cards.text: (1) 'same shape' vs 'same bag'. (2) scarcity line. (3) Unlicensed Haaland likeness. (4) 'Italian leather' not on the PDP. (5) Pick the creators for the other two renders (~100 api credits each).
